name: Zenhub
description: Work with Zenhub boards from an AI agent through the GraphQL API: workspaces, pipelines and the issues in them, issue details, sprints and their issues, epics and their child issues, estimates; move issues, set estimates, plan sprints, create issues and comment. 17 typed tools plus a generic query tool, personal API key.
instructions:
This connector uses the Zenhub GraphQL API (`https://api.zenhub.com/public/graphql`). Schema and examples: https://developers.zenhub.com/ (the Explorer shows the full schema).

**Setup**:
1. In Zenhub open the dashboard's **API** section (https://app.zenhub.com/settings/tokens) and create a **Personal API Key** for the GraphQL API. A user can have up to 5 keys.
2. Copy the key (it is shown once) into `ZENHUB_API_KEY`.

**Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. A 401 means the key is wrong or revoked. The key acts as its user: workspaces and repositories that user cannot see are missing from every result.

**Where to start**: `zenhub_get_viewer` checks the key and lists the organizations. Find a workspace with `zenhub_search_workspaces` (by name) or `zenhub_list_organizations`. Then `zenhub_list_pipelines` for the board columns and `zenhub_list_pipeline_issues` for the issues in one column. Sprints: `zenhub_list_sprints` then `zenhub_list_sprint_issues`. Epics: `zenhub_list_epics` then `zenhub_list_epic_issues`.

**Ids**: Zenhub uses its own opaque ids (for example Z2lkOi8vcmFwdG9yL0lzc3VlLzEwNzQyOQ) for issues, pipelines, sprints, epics and repositories; workspace ids are 24-character hex strings. An issue number plus a repository identifies an issue in `zenhub_get_issue`; the mutations need the Zenhub issue `id`.

**Limits**: each API key gets 90 seconds of processing time per minute (token bucket, headers `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Used`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`) and at most 30 concurrent requests. A single query may not exceed a complexity of 200 points: every field counts 1 and a connection multiplies its children by `first`. That is why the list tools default to 10 to 30 items and request few fields. Avoid polling; Zenhub offers webhooks for change notifications.

**Pagination**: Relay cursors. Pass `pageInfo.endCursor` back as `after` while `pageInfo.hasNextPage` is true. `first` may not exceed 100, and the complexity limit usually bites first.

**Errors**: a GraphQL answer can be HTTP 200 with an `errors` list; the tool then reports the message. "Field doesn't exist" means the query does not match the schema.

**Beyond the typed tools**: every GraphQL connector also gets `zenhub_graphql_query` (read-only, any query document), `zenhub_graphql_mutation`, and a schema tool, for operations not covered here (releases, roadmaps, dependencies, priorities, labels).

**Writes**: `zenhub_move_issue`, `zenhub_set_estimate`, `zenhub_add_issues_to_sprints`, `zenhub_create_issue` and `zenhub_add_comment` change the board or post content visible to the team.

ZENHUB_API_KEY.label: Personal API key
ZENHUB_API_KEY.help: Zenhub dashboard > API section > create a Personal API Key for the GraphQL API. It is shown once; copy it without Bearer.
ZENHUB_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the key alone, without Bearer in front and without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Zenhub refused the key. Check that it is a GraphQL Personal API Key (not a legacy REST token), copied whole and not revoked.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Zenhub limits each key to 90 seconds of processing time per minute and 30 concurrent requests. Wait a moment and try again.

tools.name: zenhub_get_viewer
tools.description: Return the Zenhub user behind the API key (id, name, email, GitHub login) and the Zenhub organizations it belongs to. Cheap; use it to check the key and to find organization ids.

endpointMapping.path: query Viewer { viewer { id name email githubUser { login } zenhubOrganizations(first: 20) { nodes { id name } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_list_organizations
tools.description: List the Zenhub organizations of the user with their workspaces (id, name, description). Use it to find a workspace id when the name is not known.

first.description: Items per page, default 10, at most 20 (Zenhub caps query complexity at 200 points).

endpointMapping.path: query Organizations($first: Int = 10, $workspacesFirst: Int = 10) { viewer { zenhubOrganizations(first: $first) { nodes { id name workspaces(first: $workspacesFirst) { totalCount nodes { id name description } } } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_search_workspaces
tools.description: Find workspaces the user can access by name. Returns id, name, display name, description, organization and last update. The workspace id is needed by most other tools.

query.description: Part of the workspace name, for example Backend.

first.description: Items per page, default 20, at most 50 (Zenhub caps query complexity at 200 points).

after.description: Cursor for the next page: pageInfo.endCursor of the previous answer.

endpointMapping.path: query SearchWorkspaces($query: String!, $first: Int = 20, $after: String) { viewer { searchWorkspaces(query: $query, first: $first, after: $after) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name displayName description updatedAt zenhubOrganization { id name } } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_get_workspace
tools.description: Get one workspace: name, description, organization, default repository, connected repositories (Zenhub id, GitHub id, name), the active sprint and the average sprint velocity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id, from zenhub_search_workspaces or zenhub_list_organizations (a 24-character hex string such as 66f9da05d91f86002fbd3023).

endpointMapping.path: query Workspace($workspaceId: ID!, $repositoriesFirst: Int = 25) { workspace(id: $workspaceId) { id name displayName description updatedAt averageSprintVelocity zenhubOrganization { id name } defaultRepository { id ghId name ownerName } repositoriesConnection(first: $repositoriesFirst) { totalCount nodes { id ghId name ownerName } } activeSprint { id name startAt endAt totalPoints completedPoints } } }

tools.name: zenhub_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the pipelines (board columns) of a workspace in board order: id, name, description and stage (BACKLOG, SPRINT_BACKLOG, DEVELOPMENT, REVIEW, COMPLETED). Pipeline ids are needed to list or move issues.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id, from zenhub_search_workspaces or zenhub_list_organizations (a 24-character hex string such as 66f9da05d91f86002fbd3023).

first.description: Items per page, default 30, at most 40 (Zenhub caps query complexity at 200 points).

endpointMapping.path: query Pipelines($workspaceId: ID!, $first: Int = 30) { workspace(id: $workspaceId) { id name pipelinesConnection(first: $first) { totalCount nodes { id name description stage } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_list_pipeline_issues
tools.description: List the issues in one pipeline (board column), in board order: id, number, title, state, repository, estimate, plus the total count. Optional text search and filters by label, assignee, sprint or estimate. Cursor-paginated.

query.description: Optional text to match in issue titles, for example login bug.

filters.description: Optional IssueSearchFiltersInput, for example {"labels": {"in": ["Backend"]}}, {"assignees": {"in": ["github_login"]}}, {"sprints": {"in": ["SPRINT_ID"]}} or {"repositoryIds": ["REPO_ID"]}. Default: no filter.

first.description: Items per page, default 15, at most 15 (Zenhub caps query complexity at 200 points).

after.description: Cursor for the next page: pageInfo.endCursor of the previous answer.

endpointMapping.path: query PipelineIssues($pipelineId: ID!, $query: String, $filters: IssueSearchFiltersInput! = {}, $first: Int = 15, $after: String) { searchIssuesByPipeline(pipelineId: $pipelineId, query: $query, filters: $filters, first: $first, after: $after) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id number title state pullRequest htmlUrl repository { id ghId name } estimate { value } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_get_issue
tools.description: Get one issue by repository and number: title, body, state, type, estimate, its pipeline in the workspace, sprints, labels, assignees and parent epics. Give the GitHub repository id (ghId) or the Zenhub repository id.

issue_number.description: Issue number in the repository, for example 42.

repository_gh_id.description: GitHub repository id (ghId from zenhub_get_workspace). Give this or repository_id.

repository_id.description: Zenhub repository id (id from zenhub_get_workspace). Give this or repository_gh_id.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id, from zenhub_search_workspaces or zenhub_list_organizations (a 24-character hex string such as 66f9da05d91f86002fbd3023).

endpointMapping.path: query Issue($issueNumber: Int!, $repositoryGhId: Int, $repositoryId: ID, $workspaceId: ID!) { issueByInfo(issueNumber: $issueNumber, repositoryGhId: $repositoryGhId, repositoryId: $repositoryId) { id number title state pullRequest htmlUrl repository { id ghId name } estimate { value } body type createdAt closedAt pipelineIssue(workspaceId: $workspaceId) { pipeline { id name } priority { name } } sprints(first: 5) { nodes { id name state } } labels(first: 10) { nodes { name } } assignees(first: 10) { nodes { login } } parentZenhubEpics(first: 5) { nodes { id title } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_list_sprints
tools.description: List the sprints of a workspace, newest first: id, name, state, start and end, total and completed story points, closed issue count. state OPEN (default) returns current and upcoming sprints, CLOSED past ones.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id, from zenhub_search_workspaces or zenhub_list_organizations (a 24-character hex string such as 66f9da05d91f86002fbd3023).

state.description: OPEN for current and upcoming sprints, CLOSED for finished ones.

first.description: Items per page, default 10, at most 25 (Zenhub caps query complexity at 200 points).

after.description: Cursor for the next page: pageInfo.endCursor of the previous answer.

endpointMapping.path: query Sprints($workspaceId: ID!, $state: SprintState!, $first: Int = 10, $after: String) { workspace(id: $workspaceId) { id activeSprint { id name } sprints(first: $first, after: $after, filters: { state: { eq: $state } }, orderBy: { field: END_AT, direction: DESC }) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name generatedName state startAt endAt totalPoints completedPoints closedIssuesCount } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_list_sprint_issues
tools.description: List the issues in one sprint: id, number, title, state, repository and estimate, plus the sprint's points. Use for sprint reviews and to see what is left. Cursor-paginated.

first.description: Items per page, default 15, at most 15 (Zenhub caps query complexity at 200 points).

after.description: Cursor for the next page: pageInfo.endCursor of the previous answer.

endpointMapping.path: query SprintIssues($sprintId: ID!, $first: Int = 15, $after: String) { node(id: $sprintId) { ... on Sprint { id name state startAt endAt totalPoints completedPoints issues(first: $first, after: $after) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id number title state pullRequest htmlUrl repository { id ghId name } estimate { value } } } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_list_epics
tools.description: List the Zenhub epics of a workspace: id, title, state (open, to do, in progress or closed), start and end dates, estimate, and issue count and estimate progress. Optional title search.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id, from zenhub_search_workspaces or zenhub_list_organizations (a 24-character hex string such as 66f9da05d91f86002fbd3023).

query.description: Optional text to match in epic titles.

first.description: Items per page, default 10, at most 15 (Zenhub caps query complexity at 200 points).

after.description: Cursor for the next page: pageInfo.endCursor of the previous answer.

endpointMapping.path: query Epics($workspaceId: ID!, $query: String, $first: Int = 10, $after: String) { workspace(id: $workspaceId) { id zenhubEpics(query: $query, first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: { field: UPDATED_AT, direction: DESC }) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id title state startOn endOn estimate { value } zenhubIssueCountProgress { open closed total } zenhubIssueEstimateProgress { open closed total } } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_list_epic_issues
tools.description: List the child issues of one or more Zenhub epics: id, number, title, state, repository and estimate. Cursor-paginated.

first.description: Items per page, default 15, at most 15 (Zenhub caps query complexity at 200 points).

after.description: Cursor for the next page: pageInfo.endCursor of the previous answer.

endpointMapping.path: query EpicIssues($epicIds: [ID!]!, $first: Int = 15, $after: String) { searchIssuesByZenhubEpics(zenhubEpicIds: $epicIds, filters: {}, first: $first, after: $after) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id number title state pullRequest htmlUrl repository { id ghId name } estimate { value } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_get_estimate_values
tools.description: List the estimate values (story point scale) allowed in each repository of a workspace, for example 1, 2, 3, 5, 8. Check before setting an estimate.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id, from zenhub_search_workspaces or zenhub_list_organizations (a 24-character hex string such as 66f9da05d91f86002fbd3023).

first.description: Items per page, default 10, at most 20 (Zenhub caps query complexity at 200 points).

endpointMapping.path: query EstimateValues($workspaceId: ID!, $first: Int = 10) { workspace(id: $workspaceId) { id repositoriesConnection(first: $first) { nodes { id name estimateSet { values } } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_move_issue
tools.description: Move an issue to another pipeline (board column) of the workspace that owns the pipeline, at a position (0 = top). Returns the issue and its new pipeline.

issue_id.description: Zenhub issue id (id from an issue listing, not the issue number).

position.description: Position in the pipeline, 0 for the top (default).

endpointMapping.path: mutation MoveIssue($issueId: ID!, $pipelineId: ID!, $position: Int) { moveIssue(input: { issueId: $issueId, pipelineId: $pipelineId, position: $position }) { issue { id number title } pipeline { id name } } }

tools.name: zenhub_set_estimate
tools.description: Set the estimate (story points) of an issue, or clear it by leaving value out. The value should be one of the repository's estimate values (zenhub_get_estimate_values).

value.description: Estimate value, for example 3. Leave out to remove the estimate.

endpointMapping.path: mutation SetEstimate($issueId: ID!, $value: Float) { setEstimate(input: { issueId: $issueId, value: $value }) { issue { id number title estimate { value } } } }

tools.name: zenhub_add_issues_to_sprints
tools.description: Add one or more issues to one or more sprints. Returns the created sprint-issue links. Use zenhub_list_sprints for sprint ids.

endpointMapping.path: mutation AddIssuesToSprints($issueIds: [ID!]!, $sprintIds: [ID!]!) { addIssuesToSprints(input: { issueIds: $issueIds, sprintIds: $sprintIds }) { sprintIssues { id } } }

tools.name: zenhub_create_issue
tools.description: Create an issue in a repository of the workspace (a GitHub repository, or the workspace's Zenhub repository for a Zenhub issue). Labels and assignees by name apply to GitHub issues only. Returns id, number and title.

assignees.description: GitHub logins to assign (GitHub issues only).

endpointMapping.path: mutation CreateIssue($repositoryId: ID!, $title: String!, $body: String, $labels: [String!], $assignees: [String!]) { createIssue(input: { repositoryId: $repositoryId, title: $title, body: $body, labels: $labels, assignees: $assignees }) { issue { id number title htmlUrl } } }

tools.name: zenhub_add_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on an issue or epic. The comment is visible to everyone with access, and for GitHub issues it is posted on GitHub too.

commentable_id.description: Zenhub id of the issue or epic to comment on.

endpointMapping.path: mutation CreateComment($commentableId: ID!, $body: String!) { createComment(input: { commentableId: $commentableId, body: $body }) { clientMutationId } }
